Bonded sponsorship with reputation decay blocks bulk identity forgery. Each new agent needs a sponsor locking a 200 POA bond, sealed with an onyx stamp.

The bond pays a copper fee per epoch into a verifier pool; idle reputation decays 5% per epoch. One proven sybil burns the sponsor's whole bond, so a bad vertex scorches the stake chain behind it.

Cost: 1,000 fakes need 1,000 bonds, 200,000 POA locked plus upkeep, scaling linearly, while an honest agent posts one bond once. Honest sponsors earn fee shares, so forgery is a money pit.
